description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller named HomeController that provides helper routes for redirection to Swagger UI and a legacy Swagger UI entry point.

classes.name: HomeController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller that provides endpoints to redirect to Swagger UI and maintain legacy routes.

methods.name: homeFallback
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/home' and redirects to the Swagger UI index page.

methods.name: legacySwaggerUiRedirect
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/swagger-ui.html' and redirects to the canonical Swagger UI path.
